lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in three to four distinct horizontal rows along the lateral flank, with the most defined centroids located in the mid-body region posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a matrix of grid-like anchor nodes across the central visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a high-luminance dorsal edge transitioning into a distinct shadow gradient along its ventral boundary.
